nodes.title: gpt-image-2.5-flare vs gpt-image-2, quality low, 1024x1024, eastus2 from a US container: flare 14.6/15.4 s (n=2), image-2 27.7/17.1/19.3 s (n=3, p50 19.3 s); both 196 output tokens per image; same retail price ($30/1M image output tokens => ~$0.006 per low image). Claimed 50% faster not reproduced: ~20% at n=2-3. Several 429s at 4 RPM

Default image model is gpt-image-2.5-flare at quality low (owner pick; same price as gpt-image-2, measured faster), overflow to a gpt-image-2 pool. Supersedes the gpt-image-2-only default. Reverse if blind quality checks put flare below image-2 or flare quota cannot be raised

Image capacity: flare quota is subscription-wide (4 RPM total: eastus2 2 + uaenorth 2); gpt-image-2 quota is per region, so gpt-image-2 is deployed at 4 RPM in uaenorth, polandcentral, swedencentral, westus3 and eastus2 (20 RPM). The image lane must route flare first, then gpt-image-2 nearest-first (UAE, Poland, Sweden, US) with 429 failover, serve library/prefetched images first (>=90% hit target), and file a quota increase for flare before launch. Reverse when one deployment's quota covers peak demand
